correctness.rationale: For F_P pointwise nilpotent, the stated polynomial conjugacy yields G_P=(P(Y)-P(Z),Z,(P(Y)-P(Z))^2). Period-three repeated-height recurrence forces heights (s,s,0) with s>0 and P(s)^2=s. Factoring P=sQ produces sQ(s)^2=1 of degree 2d-1; the explicit high-kappa product polynomial crosses twice in each (j-1,j) and once beyond d-1, giving all roots simple and persistent. Return multiplier is 4sP prime(s)^2, and for large-kappa attaining family each root has multiplier>1 while other two are zero. Quadratic P=kappa*s(s-1) has collision at K=27/4, attraction of the middle branch on (27/4,125/12), and superattraction K=8. Independent exact substitution verifies each threshold, not all-degree existence.
